require "settings"

RSpec.describe Homebrew::Settings do
  before do
    HOMEBREW_REPOSITORY.cd do
      system "git", "init"
    end
  end

  def setup_setting
    HOMEBREW_REPOSITORY.cd do
      system "git", "config", "--replace-all", "homebrew.foo", "true"
    end
  end

  describe ".read" do
    it "returns the correct value for a setting" do
      setup_setting
